issues.where: crops A, E and I, center through the lower-right globe
issues.what: Fine cloud detail smears into long, nearly parallel streaks. The brightest areas retain some texture, but the darker bands look brushed on rather than layered.
issues.fix: Use higher-resolution multiscale cloud detail and reduce directional stretching in the surface mapping.

issues.where: crop J, moon above the bright limb
issues.what: The granular lit portion ends against an unusually hard, smooth circular dark edge, making the moon look like two overlapping layers.
issues.fix: Render the lit and shadowed portions on one continuous sphere, then composite the planet's atmospheric glow over it.

issues.where: crop G, bright outer ring arc
issues.what: The narrow bright arc is so uniform and sharply defined against the softer ring bands that it reads like a drawn line.
issues.fix: Give the outer ring finite width and subtle density variation, and soften its brightest edge.

issues.where: crops V and W, lower-right star field
issues.what: Several bright stars resolve as soft oval blobs with colored fringes rather than compact points.
issues.fix: Use smaller antialiased star cores and reduce chromatic spread on the brightest stars.

issues.where: left side of the globe, along the terminator (crop A, P)
issues.what: the night-side shadow is a separate darker crescent with its own hard inner edge, so the globe shows a doubled edge, like a shadow layer laid over the texture instead of a smooth terminator
issues.fix: shade the terminator from the lighting model with a soft, wide falloff and drop the overlaid shadow crescent

issues.where: globe surface (crops E, G, P, Q)
issues.what: the cloud bands are soft, airbrushed brush strokes with little fine detail at native size; the white storm blobs look pasted on and smeared, so the surface reads as painted and plastic
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution band texture with fine turbulent detail, and blend the storms into the bands with shear and soft edges

issues.where: ring system round the globe (crops C, F, G, I, K, Q)
issues.what: the rings are faint, wobbly, scribbled threads that do not follow one clean ellipse; they swirl and cross each other like loose hair and only show behind the planet, with no part crossing in front
issues.fix: render the rings as concentric, coplanar ellipses with a consistent radial profile, and draw the near arc in front of the globe with its shadow on the disc

issues.where: lower half of the planet surface, near foreground (crops D, N, S, T, U, V)
issues.what: the near terrain is smeared into soft directional streaks like motion blur, with no resolvable cloud or surface detail; the darkest corner is a flat, muddy gradient with faint banding
issues.fix: add high-frequency cloud and surface detail that grows sharper toward the camera, and dither the dark gradient

issues.what: the moon is a stretched, squashed ellipse rather than a sphere, with flat, plastic shading
issues.fix: render the moon as a true sphere with a proper terminator and some surface texture

issues.what: the moon is a flat white half-disc with no surface detail, like a cutout
issues.fix: add albedo texture and a soft terminator

issues.where: ring ends at the limb, left (crop J) and right (crop H, Q)
issues.what: the ring strands end abruptly at the atmosphere glow, with no occlusion through the haze or shadow on the planet, so the join looks like a cut edge
issues.fix: fade the rings through the atmosphere where they pass behind the limb and cast the ring shadow onto the day side

issues.what: the cloud wisps are streaky and repeat the same diagonal brush direction, which looks procedural
issues.fix: vary cloud scale and orientation and add cellular and convective structure
